facts.text: Documented members of the Ottawa Tribe of Oklahoma receive full tuition, fees, and on-campus double occupancy room and board.

sources.title: How to Earn Scholarships and Awards - Ottawa University
sources.quote: This scholarship is awarded to documented members of the Ottawa Tribe of Oklahoma. Double occupancy room and board charges are covered for students who reside on campus.
